summary: @or-sdk/api-tokens preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package advertises itself as a REST API-tokens SDK but declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`, and setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers and per-function string-lookup maps wrapping URLs, argv, and execFileSync arguments. At install time setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unzips it to an OS temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB `@bun @bun-cjs`-compiled bundle whose contents are a shuffled numeric/string array plus a runtime decoder (`WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`) reconstructing all identifiers and strings at execution — opaque code unrelated to the advertised API-tokens SDK. Executing an alternate runtime specifically to run a bundled, obfuscated, purpose-mismatched payload during `npm install` is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern used to evade Node-based scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
